description: §18.9 / §34 — a bare `match subject { … }` statement written DIRECTLY in markup content (a <div> body, not inside a `${...}` logic interpolation) is E-CONTROL-FLOW-IN-MARKUP: it would ship as page text. (E-TYPE-026 is retired, S473 D19.)
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 16 (g-conf-e-type-026-case-asserts-retired-code-s478) — retargeted from the retired E-TYPE-026
rationale: S478 open-Qs ruling item 16: the hazard is the one E-CONTROL-FLOW-IN-MARKUP exists for — the statement ships as page text — so `match … { … }` joins `for` / `if` / `while` in that §34 row. Wrap it in a logic interpolation (`${ match subject { ... } }`).
